module.purpose: Provides server-side rendering utilities for dehydrating router state, serializing it into scripts, injecting rendered HTML, managing SSR lifecycle events, and producing request-aware manifests.
module.summary: This module coordinates the server half of router SSR. It prepares matched route manifests, optionally extracts inline CSS, merges request-scoped assets, serializes dehydrated matches through Seroval, buffers scripts behind a render barrier, and exposes lifecycle callbacks for HTML injection, serialization completion, rendering completion, and cleanup. It also normalizes request URLs and derives a trusted origin without relying on spoofable Origin headers.
module.businessContext: Supports production SSR and hydration for routed web applications. Failures can produce incomplete hydration, incorrect assets, unsafe redirect origins, or malformed streamed HTML.
